authority: User directed implementation of the reduced research product rather than the whole historical plan.
precedence: Research-only guide and ADR-R01 override historical feature breadth; retained wire contracts and mandatory tests remain binding.
prerequisite: G02 PASS with current source hashes

subphases.scope: Minimal tenant-aware scientific catalog, product versions, rights and measurement semantics for one SST product pair.
One ERDDAP connector with metadata-derived dimensions, approved endpoints, bounded requests and SSRF protection.
Exact-byte immutable snapshots, content hashes, provenance, QC and truthful availability times; preserve only where licensed.
Real bounded SST and compatible seasonal baseline retrieval with source rights and metadata evidence; missing evidence blocks G03.
Only the 16 selected catalog operations, with tenant/license-scoped access, cache keys, pagination and failure behavior.

study.provider: INCOIS ERDDAP candidate; alternatives require an explicit source ADR

not_in_this_phase: fisheries, alerts, consumer chat/voice, route advice and general model training (excluded)
gate_policy: Retain every named P03 test from the main plan. No mock substitutes for real product/baseline/rights evidence. Selected contracts are not evidence that handlers exist.
source_policy: Preserve registered source documents byte-for-byte; this reconciliation controls implementation instead of editing historical snapshots.
